title: [Bug] NixlPushConnector heartbeat fails to renew KV leases
body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug
Requests initially succeed. Under higher concurrency, for example Batch=128, some requests remain stuck on the Decode side.

The Prefill worker later reports:
Releasing expired KV blocks for request chatcmpl-5621e013-40d7-4414-9bd8-7c0c0f9202af-811c5361 which were retrieved by 0 remote worker(s) before lease expired.

KV transfer metrics show no successful transfer for affected requests:
Num successful transfers=0

### Environment
  - vLLM image: `vllm/vllm-openai:v0.27.1`
  - Connector: `NixlPushConnector`
  - Model: `Hy3-FP8`
  - Prefill: TP=2, `kv_role=kv_producer`
  - Decode: TP=2, `kv_role=kv_consumer`
  - Cross-node P/D deployment using UCX
  - Proxy based on:
    `examples/disaggregated/disaggregated_serving/disagg_proxy_pushconnector_demo.py`
  - Default `kv_lease_duration`: 30 seconds

  Prefill configuration:

  ```json
  {
    "kv_connector": "NixlPushConnector",
    "kv_role": "kv_producer",
    "engine_id": "prefill-engine-1",
    "kv_load_failure_policy": "fail"
  }

  Decode configuration:

  {
    "kv_connector": "NixlPushConnector",
    "kv_role": "kv_consumer",
    "engine_id": "decode-engine-1",
    "kv_load_failure_policy": "fail"
  }

### Before submitting a new issue...

- [x] Make sure you already searched for relevant issues, and asked the chatbot living at the bottom right corner of the [documentation page](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/), which can answer lots of frequently asked questions.
